fluff.overview: The branth is a large flying reptile native to the Free Worlds League world of Lopez, where early human explorers compared the winged, scaled creatures to the dragons of Terran mythology. Averaging 720 kilograms and capable of carrying one or two riders aloft, the branth was first pressed into military service by FWLM formations operating on Lopez and nearby worlds. Taming a branth requires specially trained keepers, as even domesticated specimens remain powerful and unpredictable. Attempts to export branth off-world have met with limited success due to the species' extreme susceptibility to disease, though immune system boosters developed by the late thirty-first century improved survival rates somewhat. Beast-mounted infantry riding branth exploit the creatures' aerial mobility to cover terrain inaccessible to ground forces, scouting enemy positions and striking from unexpected angles. The Branth Irregulars of the Fifth Legion remain the best-known formation to employ these mounts in combat.
